Fixes from opening the biggest builds, and a quicker way to find things inside one.

**Upgrading:** replace `usnfetch.exe` and start it as usual. Each build you've opened before works
out its games once more the first time you open it, then opens quicker after that.

## Fixes

- **Big builds no longer run out of memory while their index downloads.** A build whose file list
  comes in a few big pieces (a 23 TB one in 8) made usnfetch take 10 GB and crash. The pieces are
  now read as they arrive and written straight to disk: about 400 MB at most, and no slower.
- **The progress bar while a build opens only moves forward.** It used to jump between how far one
  piece was and how far the whole list was.
- **Finding files is much faster in big builds.** A Games search in a build of millions of files
  took over a minute; now it's a fraction of a second. Download reviews and BIOS downloads from
  Search are quicker too.
- **Old-style links read correctly.** The first version of `usn://` links was written two ways,
  and usnfetch only read one of them.

## Quicker to reopen

Opening a build used to work out its games and BIOS lists all over again, several seconds on a big
one. Now that happens once, and again only when the build is re-posted.

## Search inside a build

The search box in a build has a menu beside it: All files, Games, BIOS, Videos, Pictures, Music,
Documents, Archives. Games and BIOS match the way the Search page does, in the folder you're in,
and show the console. A game of several files (discs, tracks, regions) is one line, and ticking
it takes them all. With anything but All files chosen, an empty box lists everything of that
kind there; Escape goes back to the folder.
